# BGW Trucking LLC

> BGW Trucking LLC is a small, owner-run interstate trucking company based in Mechanicsburg, Pennsylvania (17050). It runs 53-foot dry van general freight on regional and long-haul interstate lanes out of Central PA, is authorized to carry US Mail, and has zero reportable crashes and zero out-of-service events over the last 24 months. USDOT 2779903, MC-925488. Phone: (717) 908-8887.

BGW Trucking is currently hiring CDL-A owner-operators only, who lease on and run under BGW's operating authority. It is not hiring company drivers at this time.

## Pages

- [Home](https://bgwtrucking.com/): Company overview, credentials, safety record, and services.
- [Owner-operator jobs](https://bgwtrucking.com/drivers/): Lease-on opportunity for CDL-A owner-operators, requirements, FAQ, and the online application.
- [Shippers and brokers](https://bgwtrucking.com/shippers/): 53-foot dry van capacity, lanes, US Mail authority, and the capacity inquiry form.

## Key facts

- Legal name: BGW Trucking LLC
- Base: Mechanicsburg, PA 17050 (Cumberland County, near Harrisburg; I-81 and PA Turnpike corridors)
- Operating authority: USDOT 2779903, MC-925488 (active, interstate property carrier)
- Equipment: 53-foot dry vans
- Services: OTR and regional interstate freight, general commodities, US Mail contracts, expedited and dedicated lanes
- Hiring: CDL-A owner-operators only (lease-on)
- Contact: (717) 908-8887
